CREATE PROCEDURE operation.usp_CabDataAssessment
AS
BEGIN

    SELECT
        ObjectName,
        ObjectType,
        Row_Count
    FROM operation.vw_MigrationObjectCounts
    ORDER BY ObjectType, ObjectName;

    SELECT
        SourceTable,
        Row_Count
    FROM operation.vw_CabSourceSummary
    ORDER BY SourceTable;

END;
------------------------------------------------------
CREATE PROCEDURE operation.usp_CabDataValidation
AS
BEGIN

    SELECT
        'FactCabTrip' AS ValidationObject,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS Row_Count
    FROM dw.FactCabTrip

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'NYCCabTrip_Green',
        COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM stage.NYCCabTrip_Green

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'NYCCabTrip_Yellow',
        COUNT_BIG(*)
    FROM stage.NYCCabTrip_Yellow;

END;

SELECT
    s.name AS SchemaName,
    o.name AS ObjectName,
    o.type_desc AS ObjectType
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON o.schema_id = s.schema_id
WHERE s.name = 'operation'
ORDER BY o.type_desc, o.name;
